subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint — Dedicated/Private capacity snapshot & action log
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Liu <anna.liu@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: MAP: proposed Dedicated/Private capacity snapshot — week of 5/30

Hi Anna — following our MAP review today, attaching a compact snapshot of the proposed Dedicated + Private capacity we discussed and a short action log. High-level summary below so the team can drive the evaluation plan and procurement timeline.

Proposed capacity (initial production configuration):
- US (primary): 4 x H100 80GB (low-latency serving pool) + 8 x A100 80GB (throughput pool)
- EU (failover/processing): 2 x H100 80GB + 4 x A100 80GB (partner colo in eu-west1)
- Expected sustained throughput target: 14k tokens/sec aggregate (pipelined, autoscaled to target) — target p95 infer latency < 220 ms for 512-token eval prompt
- Concurrency target (user-facing): 1200 concurrent chat sessions (avg 200 tokens/session burst profile)

Evaluation plan (3 weeks):
- Week 1: Provisioning + smoke tests (Rishi)
- Week 2: Load profile run with production prompts; measure p95 latency, token cost, and memory/KV cache hit rate (customer + Redwood)
- Week 3: Cutover rehearsal + final pricing confirmation (Aditya)

Gating metrics to proceed:
1) p95 latency < 220 ms on target prompt set
2) End-to-end cost < $X per 1M tokens (Aditya to confirm exact target)
3) Security acceptance (SOC 2 evidence reviewed by Helio procurement)

Action items (owners):
- Rishi M: provision dedicated pools in us-west1 + eu-west1, deliver by 2027-06-07. (Attachment: MAP_HELIO_v2.xlsx)
- Laura B: Share SOC2 evidence bundle, compliance checklist and runbook by 2027-06-03. (Attachment: SOC2_Evidence_Pack.pdf)
- Aditya R: Publish SKU-level pricing for committed/volume tiers and proposed DSAs by 2027-06-04. (Attachment: pricing_sku_breakdown_0527.pdf)
- Anna (Helio): Confirm procurement window and any PO constraints by 2027-06-02

Next sync: Thu 2027-06-03 10:00 PT — 30 minutes to review week-1 smoke tests and procurement blockers.

Thanks — attaching the MAP workbook and a short pricing extract.

--
Mina Haddad
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0194

Attachments: MAP_HELIO_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOC2_Evidence_Pack.pdf (pdf), pricing_sku_breakdown_0527.pdf (pdf)

From: Anna Liu <anna.liu@heliohealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@heliohealth.com, Ben Carter <ben.carter@solutions-proc.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: proposed Dedicated/Private capacity snapshot — week of 5/30

Thanks Mina — this is great, clear and actionable. A couple quick clarifications from our side:

1) Regional failover: Can you confirm recovery RTO if primary us-west1 pool goes down? We expect automatic routing to eu-west1 within 90s; please confirm networking assumptions.
2) Pricing: Our procurement team prefers a 12-month committed SKU with quarterly true-ups; Ben from our procurement is looped and will share the PO cadence.
3) Evaluation metrics: For the load run in week 2, can we add a p50/p95 breakdown for cold vs warm KV cache to better understand startup penalties?

I'll confirm PO timing by 2027-06-02. Also looping Ben so procurement has context.

Best —
Anna
Director, AI Platforms
Helio Health
anna.liu@heliohealth.com | +1 (415) 555-1313

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Liu <anna.liu@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: proposed Dedicated/Private capacity snapshot — week of 5/30

Anna — thanks, good questions. Short answers and updated owner notes below.

1) RTO: Automatic routing to eu-west1 via our multi-region routing policy is targeted sub-90s for session-level routing; cold-rebuild of model KV cache may add up to 60s in first few requests. We'll include a failover rehearsal in Week 3. (Owner: Rishi)
2) Pricing cadence: Aditya will publish a 12-month committed SKU with quarterly true-ups; we'll include volume buckets and a soft overage rate. (Owner: Aditya)
3) Metrics: We'll capture p50/p95 for cold vs warm KV states during the week-2 load runs and add those two columns to the MAP workbook. (Owner: Rishi + Helio test lead)

Updated action log:
- Rishi M: provisioning + failover rehearsal plan by 2027-06-07 (includes automation runbook)
- Laura B: SOC2 evidence + compliance runbook by 2027-06-03
- Aditya R: Committed-12mo SKU pricing + true-up schedule by 2027-06-04
- Ben C (procurement): Share PO timing and any contract flow constraints by 2027-06-02

I'll run the Week-1 smoke test on 6/1 morning PT; Rishi, please confirm resource allocation so the team can run the load profile on 6/7 as planned.

--
Mina Haddad
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Quick update — provisioning timeline and confirmation:
- I have opened the dedicated pool request for us-west1 and eu-west1 (internal ticket RDW-PROV-4721).
- Initial infra allocation: 4 x H100-80GB (us-west1), 8 x A100-80GB (us-west1), 2 x H100-80GB (eu-west1), 4 x A100-80GB (eu-west1).
- ETA for instance boot + runtime validation: 2027-06-07 11:59 PT. Will run smoke tests on 6/1 using the test image (rdw/eval:prod-smoke-202705).
- Failover rehearsal plan: schedule dry-run 2027-06-09 08:00 PT, will measure KV cold-warm deltas and update the MAP workbook with the p50/p95 breakdown.

I'll post incremental logs to the Drive link and add the provisioning checklist to the MAP workbook.

Rishi
